queries.query: Sanandaj Iran official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS
queries.result: Discovery identified the Sanandaj municipal urban-planning citizen portal (eshahr.sanandaj.ir) as a first-party map/planning-services route, and the national Registration Organization services (my.ssaa.ir and shamim.ssaa.ir) as registration/cadastre-related routes. Search results did not expose a public anonymous parcel-vector endpoint or city-specific cadastral viewer.
